description: Flat junk-drawer features directory mixing unrelated concerns, catch-all utils/helpers/common files, and inconsistent subfolder extraction for comparable peer clusters

features/reports/report-types.ts: export interface ReportRow { readonly id: string; }
features/reports/report-formatter.ts: export function formatReports(rows: ReportRow[]): string { return String(rows.length); }
features/reports/report-service.ts: export function buildReport(): string { return formatReports(fetchReports()); }
features/billing-types.ts: export interface Invoice { readonly id: string; readonly cents: number; }
features/billing-db.ts: export function saveInvoice(inv: Invoice): void { void inv; }
features/billing-tax.ts: export function computeTax(inv: Invoice): number { return Math.round(inv.cents * 0.1); }
features/billing-service.ts: export function finalizeInvoice(inv: Invoice): number { saveInvoice(inv); return computeTax(inv); }
features/auth-jwt.ts: export function verifyJwt(raw: string): boolean { return raw.length > 0; }
features/auth-session-db.ts: export function loadSession(raw: string): boolean { return verifyJwt(raw); }
features/email-smtp-client.ts: export function sendEmail(to: string, body: string): void { void to; void body; }
features/notification-banner.tsx: export function NotificationBanner({ text }: { text: string }) { return text; }
features/utils.ts: export function slugify(s: string): string { return s.toLowerCase(); }
export function formatCents(c: number): string { return `$${(c / 100).toFixed(2)}`; }
features/helpers.ts: export function retryAsync<T>(fn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> { return fn(); }
